prompt:
Who are the authors of the paper titled "{title}" ({year})?
Authors:
tokenization: encode(prompt) + encode(ASCII_SPACE + full_author); forced token ID prefixes
author_mean: arithmetic mean reciprocal rank of each author token
paper_layer: arithmetic mean over all authors; all gold authors
paper_integrated: arithmetic mean across exactly 7 selected layers
scoring: conditional teacher forcing; not free recall
